title: Magnet Datapack
description: A quick datapack that adds a magnet... ik, crazy
body:
If you ever were annoyed by all the blocks that you needed to pick up after eg. mining for dirt/sand or netherrack, then this datapack is for you

It adds a magnet (who would have guessed?) that attracts items to you in 7 block radius when holding it. That's it. Recipe:

![crafting recipe for magnet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63584ef95e36f7265f06c12dc924e5eb350858ac.png)

If you find any bugs, dm me (dc: janolo7250)
